description: Use this when the user asks if a domain name is free or what it costs. Returns live availability and yearly prices for a name across .fi and common endings, or up to 10 names at once (comma separated). Not for WHOIS/registrar details (use oma_lookup_domain_registration).

query.description: Name or domain to check for availability and price (acme, acme.fi), or up to 10 names comma-separated.

name: oma_search_domains
title: Search domain names
